## Resolved finding

1. **Major, resolved — HTTP 410 occurrence preservation.** The original occurrence validation rejected the existing `webhooks.webhook_replay_expired` HTTP 410 / `Conflict` projection and would convert it to HTTP 500 during mapping or durable restoration. `CompiledProblemRegistry::categoryForStatus()` now preserves the established 410 `Conflict` and `Validation` projections alongside `NotFound`. `WebhookReplayTest::assertReplayError()` exercises actual replay denials and checks mapper object identity plus canonical restoration of status/category/code. The adjacent framework HTTP 410 / `Validation` mapping is also consistent with the repaired policy.

One targeted repair recheck completed within this same review. The mapper now also constructs producer descriptors inside its safe-fallback boundary, with a throwing-producer regression assertion. Inspected executor evidence: `validation/review-repairs-green.log` reports 34 passed / 255 assertions. No unresolved findings.

The bounded neighboring edits were checked: CRM registers the Intl provider before catalogue freeze and updates exact scoped wire expectations; `validation/crm-repaired.log` reports 35 passed / 136 assertions. Three API mutation patches change matching context to enum constructors while retaining the identical guard-disabling mutations. No runtime CRM or guard weakening was introduced by those edits.
